notes.title: UPDATE 1228
notes.content:
1. Online Matching System, directly drop in and fight against players across Internet okay, and also you can fight among friends: first people QuickMatch and tell the roomkey, and the followers join by enter RoomKey.
2. New Gamerule: dont get crashed to death or out of the fight cage for the first map, the one who stands last win. 3 continious win to final ace!
3. Balance, being punched will get you weaker and easier to die, and punching others will get you stronger and bubble to place!(ATTENTION: bubble can also kill you)
4. Operation details:
WASD move,
SPACE Jump,
Z bubble,
LeftShift drift
LeftClick Punch/Throw
RightClick Pick
Scroll ShiftEyeSight
